meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: MUST USE when asked to find, read, list, search, inspect, fetch, export, or reconstruct coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, Senpi/pi, oh-my-pi (omp), gajae-code (gjc), OpenClaw, Factory Droid, Amp, Gemini/Kimi/Qwen CLIs, Codebuff, Roo/Kilo/Cline, Kodu, Cursor CLI, Aider, Aside browser-agent sessions, or unknown local agent logs. Covers transcripts, session IDs, rollout JSONL, state SQLite, Claude projects/pre-compact histories, OpenCode messages/parts, child/subagent linkage, cwd/model/time/token filters, archives, and cost clues. Expands fuzzy recall into parallel query lanes and first probes known stores so absent platforms are skipped cheaply. Triggers: coding agent sessions, Codex/Claude/OpenCode/Senpi/pi/oh-my-pi/omp/gajae-code/gjc/OpenClaw/Droid/Amp/Kodu/Cursor/Aider/Aside sessions, transcript search, session history, session ID, read transcript, token usage, subagent sessions, what did I do yesterday, did we already do this.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速查找和浏览AI编码助手的会话历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常使用多个AI编码工具并需要追溯之前的开发对话
copy.tagline_en: Quickly find and browse session history of AI coding assistants
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use multiple AI coding tools and need to trace back previous development conversations

howto.what: 装上后，当你问起本地编程助手的会话记录时，Claude 会先搜索电脑上的会话文件（覆盖 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），列出匹配结果并显示平台、时间、目录等信息；按需读取指定会话的完整记录，包括子任务。
howto.when: 当你要求查找、读取、列出或搜索本地编程助手（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等）的会话，或问“我昨天做了什么”“之前是否做过某事”这类回忆类问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我找最近一周 Codex 里和“部署”有关的会话。
say.note: Claude 会搜索 Codex 本地日志并按关键词筛选。

say.text: 列出昨天所有编程助手的会话，按时间排序。
say.note: 返回各平台会话列表并附时间、目录等字段。

say.text: 读取这个会话的完整记录：<会话ID>。
say.note: 显示首尾用户消息、事件和子会话。

howto.what_en: After setup, when you ask about local coding-agent sessions, Claude searches session files on your machine (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, etc.), lists matches with platform/time/dir, and can read a full session transcript including subagents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to find, read, list, search, inspect, or reconstruct local coding-agent sessions (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, etc.), or memory questions like 'what did I do yesterday'.

say_en.text: Find Codex sessions from the last week related to 'deploy'.
say_en.note: Claude will search local Codex logs and filter by keyword.

say_en.text: List all coding-agent sessions from yesterday, sorted by time.
say_en.note: Returns sessions across platforms with time and directory fields.

say_en.text: Read the full transcript for session id abc123.
say_en.note: Shows first/last user messages, events, and subagents.
